name: Do You Like Sweet OR Bitter?
source:
This is just a game where the protagonist, Hina, goes around playing tricks on her colleagues at work for Halloween.
There’re some gags and seriousness.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/10400]Freem![/url]]
